recommendations.name: Captain Sonar
recommendations.summary: Someone must listen to the enemy captain while everyone else keeps your submarine moving. A missed direction can matter more than a missed shot.
recommendations.core_rules: Two teams command hidden submarines. Navigate, charge systems, manage breakdowns and track enemy orders to find a firing position. Inflict four damage to sink the enemy submarine.
recommendations.detailed_rules: At eight, each boat has a captain, first mate, engineer and radio operator. Each reported move advances the crew’s tasks. A captain cannot cross an island or revisit the boat’s current underwater trail. The operator fits enemy directions to the map; weapons and detection systems depend on charge and working equipment. Surfacing allows repairs and clears the route but reveals the sector. Two or three players must play turn by turn; groups of four or more may choose real time.
recommendations.catalog_reason: At four against four, everyone has a distinct job and a shared target. The pleasure is in the two crews trying to outguess each other while keeping their own boat operational.

recommendations.name: The Crew: Mission Deep Sea
recommendations.summary: Sometimes the winning play is to lose a trick on purpose, because the only person allowed to take it is sitting across the table.
recommendations.core_rules: The crew share a mission made up of card-play tasks. Follow the led suit when possible; the highest trump, or highest card of the led suit if no trump is played, wins the trick. Complete every task together without openly discussing your hands.
recommendations.detailed_rules: Deal the coloured cards and four submarine trumps. The highest submarine makes its holder captain and opening leader. Assign mission tasks: some specify who must win a card, others how many tricks someone must take or avoid. Unless the mission restricts it, each player may once reveal a non-trump card and mark it as the highest, lowest or only card of its colour in their hand. A failed task means a failed mission. At two, the captain plays an additional partly visible hand.
recommendations.catalog_reason: Winning the trick is not enough: the right teammate has to win it. One carefully chosen hint can make a previously failed mission achievable.

recommendations.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game
recommendations.summary: Every lead costs time, and the investigation does not wait until you feel ready. Even an imperfect ending can become part of your campaign.
recommendations.core_rules: Choose investigators and play through a scenario together. Collect clues to advance the act while the agenda and encounter cards push the threat forward. The scenario determines the resolution and what carries into the campaign.
recommendations.detailed_rules: Each investigator normally takes three actions per investigation phase and may repeat actions such as moving, investigating or fighting. A ready enemy engaged with you can make an attack of opportunity when you perform many ordinary actions. For a skill test, commit cards with matching icons, draw a chaos token and apply modifiers. Meeting the difficulty normally succeeds; the automatic failure token overrides the total. Damage and horror have separate limits. This core set supports one to four investigators.
recommendations.catalog_reason: Two investigators make a good pair: the story stays involving, waits are shorter than at a larger table, and someone can help untangle a particularly wordy card.
